title: A Henhouse Full
offer: Eggs sell so well! Let us have six hens. Buy hens at the market in Kråkhamn or the farm of Frosttorp, and bring them home.

steps.say: Six hens! Cluck, cluck, scratch, scratch. Do not forget: they eat grain.

fact: Viking hens were small and laid fewer eggs than ours, but every farm had some.
